# Parascand Consulting

> Parascand Consulting builds AI front desk agents, AI voice agents, AI chatbots, and business automation systems that answer calls and messages 24/7, qualify leads, and book appointments automatically. Founded by James Parascand, the company serves service businesses across Northern Virginia, the Fredericksburg region, and Richmond, Virginia.

Parascand Consulting helps appointment-driven and lead-driven local businesses stop losing leads to missed calls and slow follow-up. Core outcome for clients: more booked appointments with less manual work. Primary call to action on every page is booking a free strategy session.

- Business name: Parascand Consulting (Parascand Consulting LLC)
- Founder: James Parascand
- Email: james@parascandconsulting.business
- Phone: (571) 536-7388
- Website: https://www.parascandconsulting.business
- Book a free strategy session: https://www.parascandconsulting.business/book.html
- Service area: Northern Virginia (Fairfax County, Alexandria, Arlington, McLean, Vienna, Tysons, Reston, Herndon, Falls Church, Ashburn, Leesburg, Manassas, Woodbridge), the Fredericksburg region (Fredericksburg, Spotsylvania, Stafford, Culpeper, Locust Grove), and the Richmond region (Ashland, Richmond), Virginia.
- Industries served: accounting & tax firms, insurance agencies, law firms, dental & medical practices, real estate, restaurants & hospitality, home services (HVAC/plumbing/electrical), salons & med spas, auto dealers & repair, fitness studios & gyms, contractors, property management, financial advisors, veterinary clinics.

## Services
- [AI Front Desk Agents](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-front-desk-agents.html): A tireless AI receptionist that answers every call and books the appointment.
- [AI Hostess & Reservations](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-hostess.html): An AI hostess that answers, books tables, and fields questions so your team stays on the floor.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-voice-agents.html): Human-sounding AI voice agents that handle inbound and outbound calls at scale.
- [AI Chat & Web Chat Agents](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-chatbots.html): Website chat agents that answer instantly and turn visitors into booked calls.
- [Business Automation](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/business-automation-services.html): Automate the repetitive work — follow-up, reminders, reviews, and reporting.
- [Missed-Call Text-Back](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/missed-call-text-back.html): Every missed call gets an instant text — so the lead never gets away.
- [AI Appointment Booking](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-appointment-booking.html): Let customers book themselves — online, by chat, or by voice, anytime.
- [Lead Follow-Up & Nurture](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/lead-follow-up-automation.html): Automated follow-up that turns cold and old leads into booked appointments.
- [Reputation & Review Management](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/reputation-review-management.html): Automatically request, monitor and respond to reviews to grow your 5-star reputation.
- [Unified Inbox (Phone, Text, Email, Social)](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/unified-inbox.html): Every call, text, email and message in one place — nothing gets missed.
- [CRM & Pipeline Management](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/crm-pipeline-management.html): See exactly where every lead and deal stands — and what to do next.
- [AI Marketing & Social Content](https://www.parascandconsulting.business/services/ai-marketing-content.html): AI-assisted email, SMS and social campaigns that keep you top of mind.
